designSystem: ATOM + Nirmata Holdings Brand Design Standard
adoptionMethodNote: This app is a single static index.html deployed by Vercel with no build step. The canonical CSS custom properties (teal ladder, near-black surface stack, type scale, motion, window-chrome tokens) are inlined into the <style> block of index.html rather than imported, to preserve the zero-build static deploy. Legacy --am-* component variables are aliased onto the canonical tokens so existing component rules inherit the canonical palette.

productAccents.governance: Shared ATOM identity (orbital logo, nucleus, traveling electron, loader, focus ring, live signals) always stays canonical teal #00F0DF. Product/data channels below are used with restraint for KSE sports-data and agent-outcome moments only — one accent per surface.

syncMethod: Inlined, not imported. To update: re-read the canonical tokens from src/app/globals.css and public/tokens.json at the new upstream commit, update the :root token block and the legacy --am-* aliases in index.html, bump upstreamVersion/upstreamCommit here, then re-run `npm run check:brand` and `npm run test`.
rollback: git revert the adoption commit, or restore index.html from the pre-adoption commit 9ec4cf1. No data migration, no dependency, and no deploy-config change is involved, so rollback is a single-file revert. See docs/ATOM-DESIGN-SYSTEM-ADOPTION.md.
driftGuard: scripts/check-brand.mjs — dependency-free node script asserting a single canonical --teal-core source of truth and zero teal-impostor hexes.
tests: scripts/test-brand.mjs — dependency-free node assertions for tokens, fonts, orbital mark, endorsement, window chrome, preserved KSE routes/content, and accessibility landmarks.
notes: See docs/ATOM-DESIGN-SYSTEM-ADOPTION.md for the full adoption record, exceptions, and rollback plan. Pilot reference: BenThingkTangk/atom-sales-os#2.
